style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: He Is Not Here
images.concept: The tomb that contains nothing — the absence that is the announcement of everything
images.imageAlt: The interior of a rock-cut tomb at dawn, the burial shelf empty, grave linens folded neatly, pale dawn light entering from the open entrance
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, the interior of a rock-cut tomb at dawn, the burial shelf cut into the far wall empty, a few folds of pale linen cloth lying neatly on the stone shelf but nothing beneath them, cold dawn light entering from the open entrance at the left and falling across the rock floor, the stone walls rough and cut, the interior cool and silent, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the stone surfaces, muted palette of pale stone and white linen and cold dawn light, Alabaster Books profound emptiness, 16:9 with the entrance light coming from the left and the empty burial shelf visible on the far wall in the right portion of the frame, the neatly folded cloth the only object

images.title: Did Not Our Hearts Burn?
images.concept: A journey taken in grief, a stranger who opens the scriptures, recognition in the breaking of bread
images.imageAlt: A long straight road toward a small village at dusk, the road warm with the last light, the destination small but distinct
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a long straight road leading toward a small village visible at the horizon in warm dusk light, the road warm amber in the last sun, the village small and distinct — a cluster of pale stone buildings — the road empty, the last light of the day coloring everything with warmth before the dark, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the sky, muted warm palette of amber road and pale distant village and fading golden sky, Kinfolk journey and arrival, 16:9 with the road running from the lower center to the distant village, the known destination reached at the moment everything is understood

images.title: Peace Be with You
images.concept: The appearance in the locked room — the body that passes through walls and eats fish
images.imageAlt: A stone room interior with a table, a lamp burning, a piece of roasted fish on a clay plate, the room otherwise empty
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a spare stone room interior with a low table, a small oil lamp burning with steady flame, a simple clay plate with the remains of roasted fish — evidence of a meal just shared — the room otherwise empty, the lamp the only light source, its warm glow limited to the table and the near wall, surrounding stone in shadow, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the shadow areas, muted warm palette of clay and pale fish and amber lamp glow against gray stone walls, Alabaster Books intimate aftermath, 16:9 with the table and lamp in the center and the stone walls receding into shadow, the evidence of the impossible meal

images.title: He Was Carried Up into Heaven
images.concept: The blessing hand lifted up — departure and sending simultaneously, the disciples returning with great joy
images.imageAlt: An upward view into an olive grove canopy, the branches opening toward a bright sky, the light overwhelming at the center
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, looking directly upward through the canopy of an ancient olive grove, the dark twisted branches framing a central opening of overwhelmingly bright sky, the light at the center overexposed to pure white, the branches darkening toward the frame edges, the upward direction the entire subject, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the branch textures, muted palette of dark twisted branches and overexposed white-gold light at the center, Alabaster Books upward gaze, 16:9 with the bright sky opening at the center and the branches as a dark frame around the light, departure and light as a single undivided thing
